headline: US Clears Sale of 22 Gazprom-Branded Stations in Bulgaria, Freezes Proceeds
summary: The US has authorized the sale of Serbian oil company NIS's Bulgarian and Romanian businesses, including 22 Gazprom-branded stations in Bulgaria. All proceeds must remain frozen in a US bank account.
why: NIS is a Serbian oil company whose ownership and sanctions status affect its fuel retail operations in the Balkans. Sanctions licences determine whether asset sales can proceed.
